prompt: This oil painting depicts a lush botanical greenhouse filled with vibrant greenery and distinct figures. On the left, a woman in a yellow hat stands beside a tall fern, her posture upright as she observes the foliage. Next to her, a small orange cat sits calmly on a wooden bench, its tail curled neatly around its paws. In the center, a man in a blue coat holds a watering can, tilting it gently to water a large potted orchid that blooms with purple petals. Beside the orchid, a brown dog lies on the tiled floor, resting its head on its front paws while watching the man work. To the right of the man, a child in a green dress points excitedly at a hanging ivy plant, her arm extended toward the trailing leaves. An elderly woman in a white shawl sits on a stone ledge nearby, knitting with gray yarn while looking at the child. A black bird perches on the metal frame above them, its head tilted as it surveys the scene. Near the back wall, a gardener in overalls leans against a stack of terracotta pots, wiping sweat from his brow with a handkerchief. A red wheelbarrow rests next to him, filled with soil and gardening tools. In the foreground, a glass jar containing a small succulent sits on a low table, catching the light. A butterfly with blue wings flutters near the jar, hovering just above the glass surface. A young boy in a striped shirt crouches near the table, peering closely at the butterfly with wide eyes. An open book lies on the ground next to the boy, its pages slightly ruffled by the breeze. A wicker basket filled with fresh flowers sits near the entrance, positioned next to a closed wooden door. There is no electric lighting visible in the space, relying solely on natural illumination. There is no modern technology or electronic devices present in the scene.
